_comment: Hand-kept, reviewed in PRs. The eight templates, in three layers (shell, blocks, overlays): the shells a page, a block or an overlay is built from. Each row keeps only its layer and its page's first line (the `purpose` of its DocsLanding); the import line and the Storybook page come from the barrels and source, through the DS facts (scripts/lib/ds-facts.mjs). Rendered into components/index.md by npm run generate:agent; scripts/lib/templates-index.mjs holds every name to the facts and every template to a row, and npm run check:template-roster holds every layer to the same eight.

templates.name: Frame
templates.use: Every full page starts in the app frame: the Sidebar beside the Page, with the AI panel as its own region. Two types: default and bare. A multi-step task runs in the Sidebar's inner mode.

templates.name: Page
templates.use: The content inside a Frame: a page header, then Sections on the 12-column grid. Three types: default, full width and reading.

templates.name: Section
templates.use: A span of the page grid under one heading: a header, a body, and an optional side, detail and footer. The header owns the title row, the views and the filters.

templates.name: Card
templates.use: A container for one student, session, metric or other object, with slots for an image, header, body and footer.

templates.name: Table
templates.use: The Table template is how a table sits on a page. A Section holds the table, and the Section header carries the title, the actions, Search and the filters. The table spans the section under it, plain, with no card around it and no padding of its own. Pick a Static, Dynamic or Tree table, and the template adds the footer and the empty state box.

templates.name: Modal
templates.use: A dialog for one task before anything else can happen, centered over a Blanket. Four types: Passive, Active, Acknowledge and Steps.

templates.name: Panel
templates.use: A full-height layer on the right with no Blanket: docked beside the Page when it fits, floating over it when it does not. Two types: Details and Notifications. The AI panel is a region of the Frame.

templates.name: Popup
templates.use: A floating layer that hangs off its trigger and closes on an outside click. Six types: menu, profile menu, select list, content, filter menu and stacked filter menu.
